description: Completely rebuilt, natural, classical Keerthanas across 18 canonical masterworks. Features exact rhythmic eduppu offsets, multi-script sahitya, progressive sangatis, Kudimiyamalai singing vocables, swarasthana subscripts, and synchronized synthesizer semitone triggers.

curriculum_tiers.label: Golden Masterworks of the Musical Trinity (Songs 5-8)
Expansive Devotional Classics & Tāna Varṇam Bridge (Songs 13-18)
curriculum_tiers.description: Universal prayers (Brahmam Okaṭē, Jagadōddhāraṇā), plain staccato ear-training (Śakti Sahita Gaṇapatim), Saraswati invocation (Śrī Sarasvati Namōstutē), premier pedagogical Tāna Varṇam (Ninnukōri), and baseline Māyāmāḷavagauḷa concert piece (Māyātīta Svarūpiṇi).
